name: Branteez
description: Branteez was a terrestrial world located in the Branteez system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. At some point by the date 38:1:15, a Shrine of Kooroo, one of a number of stone structures of mysterious origins found on several Outer Rim worlds, had been uncovered on Branteez—a fact which the investigative reporter Andor Javin noted in a TriNebulon News report issued on that date.
lead_paragraphs: Branteez was a terrestrial world located in the Branteez system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. At some point by the date 38:1:15, a Shrine of Kooroo, one of a number of stone structures of mysterious origins found on several Outer Rim worlds, had been uncovered on Branteez—a fact which the investigative reporter Andor Javin noted in a TriNebulon News report issued on that date.
